subject: Draft: Data handling checkpoints & ownership for MAP — request for confirmation
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Linda Chen <linda.chen@healthedge.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Draft: Data handling checkpoints & ownership for MAP — request for confirmation

Hi Linda / team — great conversation earlier today. Quick post-call recap and a compact draft of the MAP milestones specific to data handling / compliance so we can lock owners and a target close date. Please review the three items below and confirm whether the owners/dates look right or if you need different SLAs.

Key asks from the call:
- HealthEdge needs confirmation that PHI/PII routing will stay in-customer VPC endpoints and that retained logs meet 7-year retention for audit.
- HealthEdge legal asked for a sample audit trail and retention policy language (we said we'd provide an excerpt).
- Mutual ask: ensure a KMS integration plan and key rotation window is defined before go-live.

Draft MAP milestones (data handling slice) — proposed owners & dates:
1) Retention policy finalization — owner: HealthEdge Legal (Linda) / Redwood legal support: Marissa — target: 2026-12-06 — dependency: final contract redlines.
2) Audit logging spec + sample export — owner: Redwood (Dylan) — target: 2026-11-29 — dependency: provide sample logs to HealthEdge for review. Attachment: AuditTrail_Sample.txt.
3) PHI/PII flow verification & network diagram — owner: HealthEdge infra (Linda) / Redwood infra support (Monica) — target: 2026-12-13 — dependency: VPC peering test window.
4) KMS integration plan & rotation policy — owner: Redwood infra (Monica) / HealthEdge security — target: 2026-12-20 — dependency: KMS credentials and approval.

Immediate next steps (this week):
- We (Redwood) will attach the audit-trail excerpt and a short SOC2 summary (attached). — Dylan (by EOD 11/22).
- HealthEdge to confirm which legal clause variant (A/B) you prefer for retention (Linda). — reply by 11/24 if possible.
- If the dates above look off, reply with suggested dates and owners.

Attaching: HE_MAP_DataMilestones_v2.xlsx (workable MAP), AuditTrail_Sample.txt (sanitized log excerpt), SOC2-summary.pdf (controls summary).

Thanks — happy to walk through this in a 20-min call if that helps.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

From: Linda Chen <linda.chen@healthedge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthEdge Legal <legal@healthedge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Data handling checkpoints & ownership for MAP — request for confirmation

Thanks, Dylan — appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm owners/dates: 

1) Retention: Our compliance team will require explicit language that PHI retention is configurable by us up to 7 years and that Redwood will not access raw PHI for debugging unless explicitly authorized. Can you indicate whether that phrase is acceptable? 

2) Audit trail: we need the sample to show event-level granularity for read/write access, token identifier (anonymized), IP and timestamp — can you confirm the sample includes all of those fields?

3) KMS: we are planning to use our AWS KMS key (external) — important that Redwood supports customer-managed keys. Are there any limitations we should know of?

Looping in Legal (legal@healthedge.com) — they will review the retention clause. Also looping in our infra lead (cc'ed in next note) who will confirm VPC peering timetable.

If you can confirm items 1–3 in a short reply, we can lock the retention milestone and share the legal reviewer by 11/24.

-Linda
Head of Product Security, HealthEdge
linda.chen@healthedge.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Linda Chen <linda.chen@healthedge.com>; HealthEdge Legal <legal@healthedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Data handling checkpoints & ownership for MAP — request for confirmation

Linda — thanks, and great questions. Short answers up front, then a small expanded note and where to find the excerpt.

1) Retention clause: We can accept a clause that allows customer-configured retention up to 7 years and add explicit language that Redwood will not access raw PHI for debugging without documented, auditable authorization (we can add a process step in the MAP). Proposed wording (excerpt in HE_MAP_DataMilestones_v2.xlsx, tab: Legal-Clauses).

2) Audit trail sample: The attached AuditTrail_Sample.txt includes event_type (read/write), resource_path, anon_token_id, requester_ip, timestamp, action_result and a retention_id. See sample lines 12–30 for a PHI-access case (all PHI identifiers sanitized).

3) KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS). We support AWS KMS and external key wrapping via a HSM integration. Limitations: rotation windows under 24 hrs must be coordinated; initial key import requires the KMS key to be available during onboarding (we list required steps in the sheet). Monica will handle the technical onboarding.

Updated milestone table (screenshot pasted below inlined as text):
- Retention policy finalization — owner: HealthEdge Legal (Linda) / Redwood Legal (Marissa) — target: 2026-12-06 — blockers: final contract redlines + Legal sign-off.
- Audit logging sample acceptance — owner: HealthEdge Sec (Linda) / Redwood (Dylan) — target: 2026-11-29 — success criteria: HealthEdge signs off on sample columns + export format.
- Infra verification (VPC & PHI flow) — owner: HealthEdge Infra / Redwood Infra (Monica) — target: 2026-12-13 — blockers: peering window + test data token.
- KMS integration & test rotate — owner: Redwood Infra (Monica) / HealthEdge Sec — target: 2026-12-20 — blockers: KMS key availability + security review.

HubSpot: I updated the MAP in HubSpot — see link in metadata.

Next immediate items I will do today:
- Share the sanitized audit-trail export (attached).
- Add explicit retention language in the MAP worksheet for Legal to review (Marissa).

Monica — can you confirm the typical onboarding lead time for a customer-provided AWS KMS key so we can set realistic dates?

Thanks —
Dylan

> On Nov 22, 2026, at 3:10 PM, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Linda Chen <linda.chen@healthedge.com>; Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, HealthEdge Legal <legal@healthedge.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Data handling checkpoints & ownership for MAP — request for confirmation

Linda / team — thanks for the quick review. A couple operational notes from legal/product standpoint: 

- The retention clause language Dylan proposed is acceptable from Redwood's side; we will include a short appendix describing the documented authorization flow for debugging PHI (audit ticket + signed request). I will drop that into the MAP sheet and share by 11/26.
- Monica: onboarding note — for a customer-managed AWS KMS key, typical lead time is 5 business days from key availability + backlog window (we can compress if HealthEdge can provide the key and a technical contact). Can confirm exact calendar dates after Linda shares the infra lead.
- Linda: if HealthEdge Legal can mark the clause as "A" or "B" by 11/24 we will set the retention milestone to 12/06. If not, propose we re-target to 12/13.

Action items (owner / due):
- HealthEdge Legal: pick retention clause variant A/B (due 2026-11-24) — Linda / legal@healthedge.com.
- Dylan: provide any extra audit-trail column mapping doc (DONE, attached).
- Monica: produce KMS onboarding checklist and estimate (due 2026-11-27).
- Marissa: drop legal appendix language into MAP and flag to HubSpot (due 2026-11-26).

Linda — once you share your infra lead's email I will loop them into the KMS and peering task so we have a single thread for test windows. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min joint call next week to walk through the steps and sign-offs.

Appreciate it —
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & GTM | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0214
